title: U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. v. Chairman, Permanent Lok Adalat, Bareilly
coram: Yashwant Varma, J.; Sangeeta Chandra, J.; Ravi Nath Tilhari, J.
disposition: No interim interference with the Permanent Lok Adalat order; notice issued; later passed over.
headnote: U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. challenged a Permanent Lok Adalat, Bareilly order in a transformer-shifting dispute. The High Court found no ground to interfere at the interim stage, issued notice to the consumer, and later passed the writ over for non-appearance. The U.P. Electricity Supply Code 2005 shifting procedure was not construed.
facts: U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. challenged a Permanent Lok Adalat, Bareilly order dated 22 August 2019 in PLA Case No. 24 of 2019 (Smt. Begum Sajida Haq versus UPPCL), relating to shifting of transformers under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code 2005. Counsel first sought time to study the Code procedure. On 18 November 2019 the Court found no ground for interim interference, issued notice to Begum Sajida Haq, and listed the matter for January 2020. On 10 January 2020 none appeared for the petitioners and the case was passed over.

holding_units.topic: interim non-interference with Permanent Lok Adalat order
holding_units.holding: On a writ by U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. challenging a Permanent Lok Adalat, Bareilly order in a transformer-shifting dispute, the High Court found no good ground to interfere at the interim stage, issued notice to the consumer, and directed listing. On a later date none appeared for the petitioners and the matter was passed over. The Supply Code procedure for shifting transformers was not construed.

not_decided.point: Validity of the Permanent Lok Adalat order and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code 2005 procedure for shifting transformers
not_decided.note: Writ remains pending; the Court only declined interim interference and later passed the matter over for non-appearance.
